definitions.explanation: a theory or doctrine developed through academic research and study, typically within a specific field of scholarship

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{学説|がくせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new academic theory was published.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{学説|がくせつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧きた。
examples.english: This theory has been supported for many years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{従来|じゅうらい}→従来：12511_juurai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学説|がくせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覆|くつがえ}す→覆す：07568_kutsugaesu⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a discovery that overturned the conventional theory.

notes:
USAGE:
{学説|がくせつ} emphasizes that a theory comes from academic or scholarly research. It can refer to theories in any academic field, including science, history, linguistics, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学説|がくせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧ (to advocate a theory)
- {学説|がくせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to establish a theory)
- {学説|がくせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覆|くつがえ}す→覆す：07568_kutsugaesu⟧ (to overturn a theory)
- ⟦{有力|ゆうりょく}→有力：13007_yuuryoku⟧な{学説|がくせつ} (a leading theory)
